# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{id}/assets

Upload a file attachment to a release

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token (write access required) · **ID:** `ep-354`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |
| name | query | string | False |

**Headers:** `Content-Type`

| `attachment` | file | False | file type must be in allowed types |

## Response

**201** — api.Attachment

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Attachment ID |
| `name` | string | Filename |
| `size` | int64 | File size in bytes |

| `created_at` | time.Time | Upload timestamp |

- **400** — Empty filename or forbidden file type
- **404** — Attachments disabled, release not found, or draft without access
- **413** — File exceeds max size limit

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Draft releases are only visible to users with write access to releases unit | authorization | release.IsDraft && !canAccessReleaseDraft(ctx) |
| Release must belong to the current repository | validation | release.RepoID != ctx.Repo.Repository.ID |
| Attachments must be enabled in settings for upload | validation | !setting.Attachment.Enabled |
| Filename must not be empty for attachment upload | validation | filename == "" |
| File type must be in allowed types list for release attachments | validation | upload.Verify(buf, attach.Name, allowedTypes) returns error |
| File size must not exceed configured maximum for release attachments | validation | maxFileSize >= 0 && file.size > maxFileSize |
| API token must have repository write scope to access draft releases | authorization | ctx.Data["IsApiToken"] == true && scope lacks write:repository |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| File type not in allowed list | 400 | error | False |
| File exceeds max size | 413 | error | False |

### Error Paths

- **Attachments disabled** → CreateReleaseAttachment → 404
- **Release not found** → checkReleaseMatchRepo → 404
- **Empty filename** → CreateReleaseAttachment → 400
- **Forbidden file type** → CreateReleaseAttachment → 400
- **File too large** → CreateReleaseAttachment → 413
